paragraphs: In Pesachim 101b Rav Idi bar Avin said to Rav Chisda: “So we learned it in the baraita of the school of Rav Hinak — and some say, in the baraita of the school of Bar Hinak.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole preceding Pesachim 101b paragraph places Rav Idi bar Avin before Rav Chisda, who reports Rav Huna’s teaching. The next paragraph gives Rav Hinak/Bar Hinak as alternatives. Its subsequent reference to Rav Huna does not change the addressee to Rav Huna.
